patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Linear and Smartsheet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Linear and Smartsheet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Linear only if your buying job matches “Modern issue tracker for product/engineering teams — Free limited; Basic from ~$8/user/mo ” rather than Smartsheet's shape. Choose Smartsheet only if your buying job matches “Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro from $9/memb” rather than Linear's shape. Workflow advantage: Linear leans shared coverage; Smartsheet leans resource-planning, timeline-reporting. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Linear and Smartsheet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Linear is Modern issue tracker for product/engineering teams — Free limited; Basic from ~$8/user/mo annual.; Smartsheet is Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro from $9/member/mo annual..
- Company-size focus: Linear (startup, small-business, mid-market) vs Smartsheet (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Linear-leaning — vs Smartsheet-leaning resource-planning, timeline-reporting.
- Researched limits: Linear — Not for company-wide marketing/ops Work OS; Smartsheet — No free plan.

Limitations — Linear: Not for company-wide marketing/ops Work OS; Leaner automation than Jira Enterprise; Smartsheet: No free plan; Business tier pricing jump.

Poor-fit cases: Linear is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not for company-wide marketing/ops Work OS · Smartsheet is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No free plan · Avoid Linear if you actually need Smartsheet's motion (Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro fr)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
